summary.headline: Comet Omens in the Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Astrological omens for comets appearing in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, forecasting plague, famine, war, political upheaval, weather extremes, disease, religious conflict, and disasters across Babylon, Baghdad, Fars, Khuzestan, Ahvaz, and Iraq.
